basis: Written from the published specification and established practice in the field; no new sources were read. Unreviewed.

distinguishingFeatures: An operating presence of an organization, not the organization or legal entity itself.
Separates statistical establishment, registered branch and retail outlet, which different sources define differently.
Links to sites over time rather than being a building or premises record.
A branch may lack separate legal personality; the record states this instead of assuming it.

may: Resolve which establishment or branch a name, address or code refers to.
List current sites, opening hours and local services with their sources.
Check whether registration and permit evidence is present for a declared activity.
Record a change such as relocation or closure with evidence.
mustNot: Treat a branch as a separate legal person or as the parent organization without evidence.
Infer permits, mandate or authority from a listing, website or opening hours.
Expose private staff contacts or home-based business addresses.
Overwrite conflicting registry data with the latest value silently.
requiresHuman: Registering, opening or closing an establishment with authorities.
Resolving conflicting registry assertions about legal standing.

considerations: Small and home-based businesses can expose private addresses through establishment records.
Wrong closure or relocation data harms local businesses and the people who rely on their services.
Accessibility information for premises must be accurate because people plan visits around it.
affectedParties: Operators and staff of the establishment

items: An establishment is identified by a register or statistical unit number, its parent organization and its site.
Confused with the legal entity, a premises or building, an organizational unit and a store brand.
Directing people to closed or moved sites.
Attributing liability to the wrong legal entity.
Double counting units in statistics when kinds are mixed.
ISIC Rev. 4 and NACE Rev. 2 activity classifications.
LEI, ISO 17442, with GLEIF branch registration data.
